description: This Java class 'LoanRepaymentScheduleProcessingWrapper' provides methods for processing and calculating various aspects of loan repayment schedules, including fee charges, penalty charges, and installment periods within a loan management system.

classes.name: LoanRepaymentScheduleProcessingWrapper
classes.description: A utility class for processing loan repayment schedules, calculating charges, and determining installment periods.

methods.name: reprocess
methods.description: Recalculates and updates charge portions for each repayment period based on current loan charges and schedule.

methods.name: cumulativeFeeChargesDueWithin
methods.description: Calculates total fee charges due within a specified period, considering installment and percentage-based charges.

methods.name: cumulativeChargesWaivedWithin
methods.description: Calculates total waived charges within a period based on a predicate filter.

methods.name: cumulativeChargesWrittenOffWithin
methods.description: Calculates total written-off charges within a period based on a predicate filter.

methods.name: feeCharge
methods.description: Predicate to identify fee charges that are not due at disbursement.

methods.name: cumulativePenaltyChargesDueWithin
methods.description: Calculates total penalty charges due within a period.

methods.name: getInstallmentFee
methods.description: Calculates installment fee amount based on charge calculation method.

methods.name: getBaseAmount
methods.description: Determines the base amount for fee calculation considering different percentage calculation modes.

methods.name: fetchFirstNormalInstallmentNumber
methods.description: Fetches the first normal (non-down payment) installment number from a list.

methods.name: isInPeriod
methods.description: Checks if a date falls within the period of a specific installment or list of installments.

methods.name: isBeforePeriod
methods.description: Checks if a date is before the start of an installment period.

methods.name: isAfterPeriod
methods.description: Checks if a date is after the end of an installment period.

methods.name: findInPeriod
methods.description: Finds the first installment in a list that contains a specific date.
